title: Refactor crypto2dev_fd_state: union -> void *ctx + ops ptr
description:
Replace the wolfCrypt-specific union in crypto2dev_fd_state with provider-agnostic fields.

Before: union { Aes aes; wc_Sha256 sha256; RsaKey rsa; ... } wc;
After: const struct crypto2dev_algo_ops *ops; void *ctx;

Update sess lifecycle:
- open(): zero state, ops=NULL, ctx=NULL
- INIT ioctl: lookup_algo(), call ops->sess_init() which allocates ctx
- release(): if ops && ctx: ops->sess_free(ctx), memzero_explicit the state

Depends on: provider header issue
